## Summary of Findings **Key discovery: this feature already exists, fully implemented, on both the restaurant and admin sides.** There's an established "Motoboys" badge convention I can point to directly — no need to invent a new pattern. ### 1. Restaurant header — `RestauranteHeader.jsx` `C:\Users\jotac\OneDrive\Documents\DEV\deliveryhub_white_label\src\components\restaurante\RestauranteHeader.jsx` - Already imports and uses `useSolicitacoesMotoboyCount` (line 12, called line 67): `const pendentesMotoboy = useSolicitacoesMotoboyCount();` - Passes `pendentesMotoboy` down to both `MobileMenu` (line 156) and `RestauranteSidebar` (line 170) as a prop — the header itself doesn't render the badge, it's rendered by the nav-list consumers. - No standalone bell/notification icon in the header itself — the badge lives only on the "Motoboys" nav item. ### 2. Restaurant sidebar — `RestauranteSidebar.jsx` `C:\Users\jotac\OneDrive\Documents\DEV\deliveryhub_white_label\src\components\restaurante\RestauranteSidebar.jsx` Renders `links` from `getRestauranteNavLinks()` (config at `src\config\restauranteNavLinks.js`). The badge is hardcoded to the Motoboys path, lines 34-46: ```jsx {links.map((l) => (
...
))} ``` Note: this component doesn't render `l.icon` at all (only `l.label` as text) — icons aren't shown in the desktop drawer, only in the horizontal favorites bar in the header (`RestauranteHeader.jsx` line 112, ``). Config: `src\config\restauranteNavLinks.js` — `getRestauranteNavLinks(moduloDelivery, moduloSalao, pontosPreparo, tipoRestaurante)` returns the alphabetized link array; the Motoboys entry is `{ label: 'Motoboys', path: '/restaurante/motoboys', icon: 'Users' }` (relabeled "Entregadores" for non-restaurant establishment types). ### 3.
